svg.title: linear-reassociate
svg.desc: Softmax attention forms an N×N score matrix and keeps N key/value records. Linear attention drops the softmax, reassociates (QKᵀ)V = Q(KᵀV) and keeps one d_v×d_k state per head: 16,384 numbers at d_h = 128, against 2·N·128 for the KV cache (1.05M at 4K, 33.6M at 128K, 268M at 1M tokens). They break even at N = 64.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: ot = St qt , St = St-1 + vt kt ⊤

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: grows with N: N² d FLOPs, 2·N·d_h numbers
